scenes.vo: This collapse wasn't caused by too much weight.
In 1981, two walkways fell inside Kansas City's Hyatt Regency, while a crowd watched a dance.
Federal investigators tested the connections. The load that night was only about thirty-one percent of what a code-compliant connection should have held.
The crowd didn't break the rating. The rating had already been cut.
First by a weak design. Then by a change that doubled the load on a single nut.
The full investigation is on our channel.
